items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: This information has been sent to Russ Connors for whatever purposes he cares to make of it.

ctx.x: The tune that he mentions that Ziggy Elman played on, or was featured on, was "Who Will Buy My Bublikhki". The other two tunes on the session were, the big band version of "Pick a Rib," and "You and Your Love," which had a vocal by Martha Tilton.

Russ Connors' Biodiscography of Goodman does not have this information, except that it mentions that it's possible that Quinn Wilson was the bass player. So Quinn has confirmed that he was the bass player. This information has been sent to Russ Connors for whatever purposes he cares to make of it.
